name: Sky Striker Alternative – Protocol Hijack
effect:
You can only activate 1 "Sky Striker Overclock" per turn.
Link Summon 1 "Prototype Sky Striker Ace" monster from your Extra Deck by using monsters from the field and/or either player’s GY as material by returning them to the deck.
Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card’s activation.
This is treated as a Link Summon.
